jobs.description: Our purpose and ambitions About us View our open roles Our purpose We remove the friction between ambition and achievement so businesses can create and capture opportunities across borders. John Caplan CEO "I love working at Payoneer because of our purpose. Helping empower small business owners around the world is incredibly gratifying. I work with the most creative, most collaborative and inclusive group of people I've ever had a chance to work with, and together we're making a real difference in the lives of our customers and in the community here at Payoneer." Join our team Our vision A more reliable and connected cross-border economy. Our mission To connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. Borderless ambition For 20 years, Payoneer has been empowering millions of underserved businesses with the financial tools they need to grow and transact globally with confidence. We celebrated this milestone with an Ambition Hackathon. This was a natural extension of our mission, bringing together innovators, industry leaders, entrepreneurs and our employees to tackle the biggest challenges in cross-border business. Every day, our people push boundaries and make a difference. They push beyond the familiar, challenge their thinking, and grow in new ways. jobs.title: Payoneer Ways of Working (WoW)
jobs.description: Payoneer Ways of Working (WoW) About us View our open roles Payoneer takes action Our customers have ambitions that go beyond borders, and they’re competing in an environment that takes ingenuity, drive, and decisive risk-taking. Helping them thrive in the global economy takes ownership and collaboration, all around the world. That takes all of us, and that takes action. The four Payoneer Ways of Working (WoW) principles are shared expectations of how we work together and take action that will help turn our customers’ ambition into achievement. Act as our customer’s partner on the inside. We learn what our ideal customers need most, fight for them every day, and create what will help them go further. Do it. Own it. We are fearlessly accountable. We make commitments to our customers and each other, and drive towards successful outcomes in everything we do–from start to finish. Continuously improve. We experiment and build, track and measure meaningful metrics, and move at the pace of constant evolution. We celebrate mistakes, failures, and progress, and always strive for a higher standard than our last. Build each other up. We help each other grow as professionals and as people. We share what we know, give candid feedback, focus on solutions, and collaborate within and across teams so that we can all achieve more.
